fields.hero_prompt: Build gym automation for failed dues, class waitlists, attendance alerts, and trial passes.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up gym automation?

plan.angle: The top 10 are gym software vendors (Glofox, Club Automation, Gymdesk, Visual ClubMate) and Reddit threads that list billing, booking and CRM features without showing one rule an owner could switch on. This page shows four front-desk jobs at one independent gym, each with its trigger, its numbers and who hears about it: failed dues followed up on day 1 and day 4 and flagged at check-in on day 7, a canceled spin bike offered to the waitlist for 30 minutes at a time, members with no check-in for 14 days sent to their coach every Monday, and trial members with fewer than 2 visits by day 5 called by the front desk manager.
tab_stories: When a member's $64 dues payment fails in Stripe, the app emails them on day 1 and day 4, and if the dues are still unpaid on day 7 the front desk check-in screen shows a flag on their profile.

When Laszlo Wickstrom cancels his bike for the 6:00 AM spin class at 4:40 AM, the app offers bike 14 by email to Ozanne Peyton, first on the waitlist, and moves it to the next name if she has not claimed it in 30 minutes.
Every Monday at 8:00 AM the app finds members with no check-in for 14 days and sends each coach their own names in a Slack direct message, so coach Florentyna Odell gets 3 names to call.

A 7-day trial pass signed up on the website is tracked visit by visit, and any trial member with fewer than 2 visits by day 5 goes to front desk manager Gideon Thackery in a Slack direct message to call.
